body: Hidden needs found by the audit (docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md): B-1 the repository and the server image are private, so the installer asks for a GitHub token (a stranger cannot install; the owner says the repository goes public later); B-2 every installed server follows the :main tag, so an Update button would pull unwalked code; B-3 the away-from-home route (Tailscale Funnel, beta, undisclosed bandwidth cap) has never run for real.
